description: This file provides TypeScript type definitions and interfaces for a 'SmartBuffer' class, including various methods for reading and writing different numeric types, strings, and buffers, as well as configuration options for the buffer behavior.

classes.name: SmartBuffer
classes.description: A class that encapsulates a Buffer with extended methods for reading, writing, inserting, and managing data, supporting various numeric types and string/buffer operations.

methods.name: constructor(options?: SmartBufferOptions); constructor
methods.description: Creates a new SmartBuffer instance with optional configuration options.

methods.name: static fromSize
methods.description: Creates a new SmartBuffer instance with a specified size and optional encoding.

methods.name: static fromBuffer
methods.description: Creates a new SmartBuffer instance wrapping an existing Buffer with optional encoding.

methods.name: static fromOptions
methods.description: Creates a new SmartBuffer instance using a SmartBufferOptions object.
